name: neutron-plasmon

scripts.build: bun monacoWorkerTransport.ts generate && bun build.ts && npm run mogen
scripts.dev: bun monacoWorkerTransport.ts generate dev && bun build.ts dev
scripts.package: npm run validate && npm run build && npm run mopack && npm run schema && bun ../../packages/neutron-scripts/src/pack.ts
scripts.package:slim:inner: npm run validate && npm run build && npm run mopack && npm run schema && bun slimPackageGate.ts --input && bun ../../packages/neutron-scripts/src/pack.ts && bun slimPackageGate.ts
scripts.watch: bun monacoWorkerTransport.ts generate && bun build.ts watch
scripts.test:fast: npm run test:fast:model && npm run test:ui
scripts.test:package: npm run package:base && PLASMON_PACKAGE_PROFILE=base bun test ./test/package.test.ts
scripts.test:package:js-dos: npm run package:js-dos && PLASMON_PACKAGE_PROFILE=base PLASMON_RUNTIME_CONFIGURATION=js-dos bun test ./test/package.test.ts
scripts.test:package:emulatorjs: npm run package:emulatorjs && PLASMON_PACKAGE_PROFILE=base PLASMON_RUNTIME_CONFIGURATION=emulatorjs bun test ./test/package.test.ts
scripts.test:package:slim: npm run package:slim && PLASMON_PACKAGE_PROFILE=slim bun test ./test/package.test.ts
scripts.test:all: npm run test:fast && npm run test:package

description: Plasmon desktop and application environment for Neutron
